mapper.select: select name,heat from oj_course ORDER BY oj_course.heat DESC LIMIT 5
select name,sum(heat) as heat from oj_course left join oj_course_category on oj_course.category_id = oj_course_category.resource_id ORDER BY oj_course.heat DESC LIMIT 5

select distinct oj_course_lesson.resource_id,oj_course_lesson.name,oj_course_lesson.type,oj_course_lesson.difficulty, ifnull(learned_lessons.count,0) as learned_lesson_count,ifnull(practice_afterclass.count,0) as practice_count,ifnull(report.count,0) as report_count from oj_course_lesson left join (select count(oj_lesson_record.lesson_id) as count ,oj_lesson_record.lesson_id from oj_lesson_record group by oj_lesson_record.lesson_id ) as learned_lessons on learned_lessons.lesson_id = oj_course_lesson.resource_id left join (select count(oj_lesson_paper_evaluate.lesson_id) as count ,oj_lesson_paper_evaluate.lesson_id from oj_lesson_paper_evaluate group by oj_lesson_paper_evaluate.lesson_id ) as practice_afterclass on practice_afterclass.lesson_id = oj_course_lesson.resource_id left join (select count(oj_note.business_id) as count ,oj_note.business_id from oj_note where business_type = 2 and note_type = 2 group by oj_note.business_id ) as report on report.business_id = oj_course_lesson.resource_id where course_id = #{courseId}

select oj_note.user_id,oj_note.update_time.oj_note.create_time from oj_note where oj_note.business_id = #{lessonId} and oj_note.business_type = 2 and oj_note.note_type = 2 and oj_lesson_record.userId in
#{userId}
